mapper.sql: id, from_id, to_id, conversation_id, status, create_time, content
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) FROM message m WHERE (m.from_id = #{userId} OR m.to_id = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_hidden_conversation h WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.conversation_id = m.conversation_id )

SELECT FROM message WHERE id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM message m2 WHERE (m2.from_id = #{userId} OR m2.to_id = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_hidden_conversation h WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.conversation_id = m2.conversation_id ) GROUP BY m2.conversation_id ) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_hidden_conversation (user_id, conversation_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO message (from_id, to_id, conversation_id, status, create_time, content) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{conversationId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message WHERE conversation_id LIKE 'service_%' AND id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM message WHERE conversation_id LIKE 'service_%' GROUP BY conversation_id ) ORDER BY create_time DESC
